name: 北鷹鵑
illustrationTaxon: Hierococcyx hyperythrus adult; representative adult plumage, not a specific HK record

similarSpecies.distinction: 成鳥白色下體有淡灰粉色縱紋，尾端多栗色，與北鷹鵑成鳥無明顯縱紋的灰粉下體不同。
成鳥胸部有粗深栗色縱斑，腹脅有栗色橫斑，並非北鷹鵑成鳥素色下體。

rangeMap.note: Adult plain grey-pink underparts without obvious streaking; slate grey hood yellow eye-ring, relatively narrow uppertail bars. Source HK records juvenile autumn migrants, adult art is not the HK recorded individual. LC stable. Breeds NE China/Korea/Russian Far East/Sakhalin/Japan; winter grounds poorly known, include parts Borneo/Sulawesi. Map partial combined breeding/winter only; no claim Guangdong/Fujian normal winter.
